original: Paṭhamasandiṭṭhikasāmaññaphalaṃ
content: 第一個當生直接可見的沙門果

original: 182.‘‘ Sohaṃ, bhante, bhagavantampi pucchāmi–
content: 大德！那個我也詢問世尊：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusippāyatanāni seyyathidaṃ– hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā kumbhakārā gaṇakā muddikā, yāni vā panaññānipi evaṃgatāni puthusippāyatanāni, te diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti, te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mittāmacce sukhenti pīṇenti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhapenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
content: 『大德！如這些個個技能處，即：騎象兵、騎馬兵、戰車兵、弓箭兵、軍旗兵、參謀、伙食兵、尊貴王族戰士、突擊兵、大龍戰士、勇士、穿胸甲的戰士、死忠奴隸兵、廚師、理髮師、浴僕、作甜食者、作花環者、洗染匠、編織匠、蘆葦匠、製陶器者、會計師、查驗員，又或凡其它也來到這樣個個技能處，他們在當生中直接可見地依技能果生活，他們以那個使自己快樂、喜悅；使父母快樂、喜悅；使妻兒快樂、喜悅；使朋友同事快樂、喜悅，在沙門婆羅門們上使高的、導致生天的、安樂果報的、轉起天界的供養建立。

original: Sakkā nu kho me , bhante, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 同樣的，大德！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』」(182)

original: 183.‘‘ Sakkā, mahārāja.
content: 「大王！能夠。

original: Tena hi, mahārāja, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi.
content: 大王！那樣的話，就在這件事上我將反問你，

original: Yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
content: 你就如對你能接受的那樣回答它。

original: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, idha te assa puriso dāso kammakāro[ kammakaro( sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukhullokako[ mukhullokiko( syā. kaṃ. ka.)].
content: 大王！你怎麼想它：這裡，如果男子是你的奴僕、受雇者、先起床者、後就寢者、任何行為都順從者、合意行為者、可愛言語者、看人臉色者，

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ acchariyaṃ, vata bho, abbhutaṃ, vata bho, puññānaṃ gati, puññānaṃ vipāko.
content: 『實在不可思議啊，先生！實在[[abbhuta#未曾有]]啊，先生！[真是]{{note|trigger=諸福德的趣處|text=「諸福德的趣處」(puññānaṃ gati)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「功績行為的命運」(destiny of meritorious deeds)，坦尼沙羅比丘長老英譯為「功績行為的到達地(定數)」(the destination of meritorious deeds)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「功績行為之事」(this issue of meritorious deeds)。}}、諸福德的果報，

original: Ayañhi rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto manusso ;
content: 這位摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子是人，

original: ahampi manusso.
content: 我也是人，

original: Ayañhi rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti, devo maññe.
content: 這位摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子賦有、擁有[[pañca kāmaguṇā#五種欲]]自娛，看起來像天神，

original: Ahaṃ panamhissa dāso kammakāro pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukhullokako.
content: 而我是奴僕、受雇者、先起床者、後就寢者、任何行為都順從者、合意行為者、可愛言語者、看人臉色者，

original: So vatassāhaṃ puññāni kareyyaṃ.
content: 那個我確實應該做諸福德。

original: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan’ ti.
content: 讓我剃除髮鬚、裹上[[kāsāyāni vatthāni#袈裟衣]]後，從在家出家成為無家者。』

original: So aparena samayena kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya.
content: 他過些時候剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，會[[saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā#從在家出家成為無家者]]。

original: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāyena saṃvuto vihareyya, vācāya saṃvuto vihareyya, manasā saṃvuto vihareyya, ghāsacchādanaparamatāya santuṭṭho, abhirato paviveke.
content: 成為這樣出家者的他會住於被身自制，會住於被語自制，會住於被意自制，以最少衣食為知足者、在獨居處極喜樂者。

original: Taṃ ce te purisā evamāroceyyuṃ–
content: 如果他們這麼告知你那位男子：

original: ‘ yagghe deva jāneyyāsi, yo te so puriso[ yo te puriso( sī. ka.)] dāso kammakāro pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukhullokako;
content: 『真的，陛下！你應該知道，凡你的那位奴僕、受雇者、先起床者、後就寢者、任何行為都順從者、合意行為者、可愛言語者、看人臉色者男子，

original: so, deva, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
content: 陛下！他剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者。

original: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāyena saṃvuto viharati, vācāya saṃvuto viharati, manasā saṃvuto viharati, ghāsacchādanaparamatāya santuṭṭho, abhirato paviveke’ ti.
content: 當成為這樣出家者的他住於被身自制，住於被語自制，住於被意自制，以最少衣食為知足者、在獨居處極喜樂者。』

original: Api nu tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi–
content: 是否你會這麼說：

original: ‘ etu me, bho, so puriso, punadeva hotu dāso kammakāro pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukhullokako’ ti?
content: 『去！令那位男子就再次成為我的奴僕、受雇者、先起床者、後就寢者、任何行為都順從者、合意行為者、可愛言語者、看人臉色者。』呢？」(183)

original: 184.‘‘ No hetaṃ, bhante.
content: 「大德！這確實不是，

original: Atha kho naṃ mayameva abhivādeyyāmapi , paccuṭṭheyyāmapi, āsanenapi nimanteyyāma, abhinimanteyyāmapi naṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi, dhammikampissa rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidaheyyāmā’’ ti.
content: 那時，我們只應該對他問訊，也應該以座位起立迎接，也應該邀請，也應該以衣服、[[piṇḍapāta#施食]]、臥坐處、病人需物、醫藥必需品招待他，也應該如法地安排守護、防護、保護。」(184)

original: 185.‘‘ Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, yadi evaṃ sante hoti vā sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ no vā’’ ti?
content: 「大王！你怎麼想它：在存在這樣時，是直接可見的沙門果，或否？」

original: ‘‘ Addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante hoti sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalan’’ ti.
content: 「大德！在存在這樣時，確實是直接可見的沙門果。」

original: ‘‘ Idaṃ kho te, mahārāja, mayā paṭhamaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññattan’’ ti.
content: 「大王！這是第一個當生直接可見的沙門果被我為你告知。」(185)

content: 更勝妙的沙門果

original: 189.‘‘ Sakkā pana, bhante, aññampi diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetuṃ imehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañcā’’ ti?
content: 「大德！那麼，你還能夠告知比這些直接可見的沙門果更卓越的與更勝妙的其它當生直接可見的沙門果？」

content: 「大王！能夠。

original: 190. Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ idha, mahārāja, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
content: 「大王！這裡，[[tathāgato#如來]]、[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]、[[vijjācaraṇasampanno#明行具足者]]、[[sugato#善逝]]、[[lokavidū#世間知者]]、[[anuttaro purisadammasārathi#應該被調御人的無上調御者]]、[[satthā devamanussānaṃ#天-人們的大師]]、[[buddho#佛陀]]、[[bhagavā#世尊]]在世間出現，

original: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
content: 他以證智自作證後，告知這個包括天、魔、梵的世間；包括沙門婆羅門，包括天-人的[[pajāya#世代]]，

original: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
content: 他教導開頭是善的、中間是善的、結尾是善的；[[sātthaṃ#有意義的]]、[[sabyañjanaṃ#有文字的]]法，他說明完全圓滿、[[kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti/pakāsetha#遍純淨的梵行]]。(190)

original: 191.‘‘ Taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
content: [[gahapati#屋主]]，或屋主之子，或在某個族姓中再生者聽聞那個法。

original: So taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
content: 他聽聞那個法後在如來處得到信，

original: So tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati–
content: 具備那個信之得到的他像這樣深慮：

original: ‘ sambādho gharāvāso rajopatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.
content: 『居家生活是障礙，是塵垢之路；

original: Nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
content: [[abbhokāso pabbajjā#出家是露地]]。以居住的家，這是不容易行[[ekanta, ekaṃso#一向]]圓滿、一向清淨的[[saṅkhalikhita#磨亮海螺]]的梵行，

original: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan’ ti.
content: 讓我剃除髮鬚、裹上[[kāsāyāni vatthāni#袈裟衣]]後，[[saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā#從在家出家成為無家者]]。』

original: 192.‘‘ So aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
content: 他過些時候捨棄(捨斷)少的財富聚集，或捨棄大的財富聚集後；捨棄少的親屬圈，或捨棄大的親屬圈後，剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者。(192)

original: 193.‘‘ So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu, kāyakammavacīkammena samannāgato kusalena, parisuddhājīvo sīlasampanno, indriyesu guttadvāro[ guttadvāro, bhojane mattaññū( ka.)], satisampajaññena samannāgato, santuṭṭho.
content: 當成為這樣出家者的他住於被[[pātimokkha#波羅提木叉]]的自制自制，[[ācāragocarasampanno#具足正行行境]]，在諸微罪中看見可怕的，[[samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu#在諸學處上受持後學習]]，他具備善的身業、語業，清淨的生活維持，戒具足，在諸根上守護門，具備念與正知，已知足。(193)

original: Cūḷasīlaṃ
content: 小戒

original: 194.‘‘ Kathañca, mahārāja, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti?
content: 大王！而怎樣比丘是戒具足者？

original: Idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 大王！這裡，比丘捨斷殺生後，是離殺生者，

original: Nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
content: 住於放下棍棒的、放下刀的、有羞恥的、來到同情的、[[pāṇabhūta, pāṇabhūtesu#對一切活的生命類有憐愍的]]，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
content: 捨斷未被給與的拿取後，是離未被給與的拿取者、給予而取者、施與物的期待者，以不盜取、以自己成為乾淨的而住，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
content: 捨斷[[brahmacariya#非梵行]]後，他是梵行者、行遠離者、戒絕婬欲俗法者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
content: 捨斷[[musāvādā#妄語]]後，他是離妄語者、說真實者、隨從真實者、可靠者、可信賴者、對世間不詐欺者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti;
content: 捨斷[[pisuṇā vācā#離間語]]後，是離離間語者：

original: ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya;
content: 從這裡聽聞後，不是為了這些的分裂在那裡說者，

original: amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā, amūsaṃ bhedāya.
content: 或從那裡聽聞後，不是為了那些的分裂在這裡說者，

original: Iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā, sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā, samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
content: 像這樣，是分裂的調解者，或和睦的隨給與者、樂於和合者、愛好和合者、喜歡和合者、作和合言語之說者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti;
content: 捨斷[[pharusā vācā#粗惡語]]後，是離粗惡語者：

original: yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
content: 凡那個柔和的、悅耳的、可愛的、動心的、優雅的、眾人合意的、眾人可意的言語，是像這樣言語之說者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī, nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
content: 捨斷[[samphappalāpo#雜穢語]]後，是離雜穢語者：適當時機之說者、事實之說者、有益之說者、[[dhammavādī#如法之說者]]、如律之說者、有價值(有貯藏)的言語之說者：在適當時機的、有理由的、有節制的、伴隨利益的，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。

original: ‘ ‘ Bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato hoti… pe… ekabhattiko hoti rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā.
content: 他是離破壞[[bījagāma#種子類]]、草木類者……（中略）是晚上停止、戒絕[[akālo#非時食]]的一日一食者，

original: Naccagītavāditavisūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離跳舞、歌曲、音樂、表演觀看者，

original: Mālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離花環、香料、塗油之持用與莊嚴、裝飾狀態者，

original: Uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離高床、[[uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ#大床]]者，

original: Jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受金銀者，

original: Āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受生穀者，

original: Āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受生肉者，

original: Itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受女子、少女者，

original: Dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受男奴僕、女奴僕者，

original: Ajeḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受山羊與羊者，

original: Kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受雞與豬者，

original: Hatthigavassavaḷavapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離領受象、牛、馬、騾馬者，

original: Khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti .
content: 是離領受田與地者，

original: Dūteyyapahiṇagamanānuyogā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離從事差使、遣使者，

original: Kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離買賣者，

original: Tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離在秤重上欺瞞、偽造貨幣、度量欺詐者，

original: Ukkoṭanavañcananikatisāciyogā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離賄賂、欺瞞、詐欺、不實者，

original: Chedanavadhabandhanaviparāmosaālopasahasākārā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 是離割截、殺害、捕縛、搶奪、掠奪、暴力者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(194)

original: Cūḷasīlaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
content: 小戒終了。

original: Majjhimasīlaṃ
content: 中戒

original: 195.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事破壞種子類、草木類，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījameva pañcamaṃ, iti evarūpā bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：根種子、莖種子、枝種子、節種子，種子種子就為第五。像這樣，是離破壞種子類、草木類者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(195)

original: 196.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ sannidhikāraparibhogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事受用物的儲存，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ, iti vā iti evarūpā sannidhikāraparibhogā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：食物的儲存，飲料的儲存，衣服的儲存，車乘的儲存，臥具的儲存，香料的儲存，財物的儲存等，像這樣，是離受用物的儲存者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(196)

original: 197.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或如有些沙門、婆羅門受用信施的食物後，他們像這樣住於從事表演的觀看，

original: Seyyathidaṃ – naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ balaggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā visūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：舞蹈、歌唱、音樂、戲劇、講古、手鈴、鐃鈸、大鼓、魔術、鐵球戲、竹棒戲、特技、象打鬥、馬打鬥、水牛打鬥、公牛打鬥、山羊打鬥、公羊打鬥、公雞打鬥、鵪鶉打鬥、棍棒打鬥、拳頭打鬥、摔角、演習、兵列、軍陣、閱兵等，像這樣，是離表演觀看者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(197)

original: 198.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事賭博放逸處，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– aṭṭhapadaṃ dasapadaṃ ākāsaṃ parihārapathaṃ santikaṃ khalikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ salākahatthaṃ akkhaṃ paṅgacīraṃ vaṅkakaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulikaṃ pattāḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ akkharikaṃ manesikaṃ yathāvajjaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyogā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：八目棋、十目棋、空中棋、跳房子(沿線踢石頭)、石積戲(底部抽出堆疊在頂部)、骰子板、打木栓遊戲、手型遊戲、骰子、吹葉笛、玩具鋤遊戲、翻筋斗遊戲、玩具風車遊戲、玩具量器遊戲、車遊戲遊戲、玩具弓箭遊戲、猜字遊戲、猜想法遊戲、模仿瑕疵遊戲等，像這樣，是離賭博放逸處者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(198)

original: 199.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事高床、大床，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ gonakaṃ cittakaṃ paṭikaṃ paṭalikaṃ tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddalomiṃ ekantalomiṃ kaṭṭissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：高椅、長椅、山羊毛墊、拼色墊、白羊毛布墊、羊毛布墊、厚布墊、毛織墊、邊緣有毛繸的墊子、一邊緣有毛繸的墊子、珠寶刺繡的絹織墊、絹布墊、毛織墊、象背氈墊、馬背氈墊、車上氈墊、羊皮編織物、[[kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇāni#頂級羚鹿皮覆蓋的]]、有頂篷的、[[ubhatolohitakūpadhānāni#兩端有紅色枕墊]]等，像這樣，是離高床、大床者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(199)

original: 200.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ maṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事莊嚴裝飾狀態的實行，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ ādāsaṃ añjanaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ mukhacuṇṇaṃ mukhalepanaṃ hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ asiṃ[ khaggaṃ( sī. pī.), asiṃ khaggaṃ( syā. kaṃ.), khaggaṃ asiṃ( ka.)] chattaṃ citrupāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vālabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni iti vā iti evarūpā maṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānānuyogā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：按摩、搓揉、沐浴、擦揉、鏡子、塗眼膏、花環、香料、香膏、臉粉、塗臉膏、手鐲、緞帶髮飾、杖、筒、劍、傘、彩色鞋、髻、珠寶、拂塵、長短白衣(泰國版)等，像這樣，是離莊嚴裝飾狀態的實行者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(200)

original: 201.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事[[tiracchānakathaṃ#畜生論]]，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ[ itthikathaṃ purisakathaṃ kumārakathaṃ kumārikathaṃ( ka.)] sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānakathāya paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：國王論、盜賊論、大臣論、軍隊論、怖畏論、戰爭論、食物論、飲料論、衣服論、臥具論、花環論、氣味論、[[ñātikathaṃ#親里論]]、車乘論、村落論、城鎮論、城市論、[[ñātikathaṃ#國土論]]、女人論、英雄論、街道論(街道流言)、水井論(井邊流言)、祖靈論、種種論、世界起源論、海洋起源論、[[itibhavābhava#如是有無]]論等，像這樣，是離畜生論者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(201)

original: 202.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ viggāhikakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事諍論，

original: Seyyathidaṃ – na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi, ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi, kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi, micchā paṭipanno tvamasi, ahamasmi sammā paṭipanno, sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te, pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca, adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ, āropito te vādo, niggahito tvamasi, cara vādappamokkhāya, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosīti iti vā iti evarūpāya viggāhikakathāya paṭivirato hoti.
content: 即：『你不了知這法、律，我了知這法、律；你了知這法、律什麼！你是邪行者，我是正行者；應該先說的你後說，應該後說的你先說；我的是一致的，你的是不一致的；你長時間熟練的是顛倒的；你已被論破(你的理論已被反駁)，請你去救(使脫離)理論；你已被折伏，或請你解開，如果你能夠。』等，像這樣，是離諍論者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(202)

original: 203.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ dūteyyapahiṇagamanānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣住於從事遣使行走的實行，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– raññaṃ, rājamahāmattānaṃ, khattiyānaṃ, brāhmaṇānaṃ, gahapatikānaṃ, kumārānaṃ–
content: 即：為國王們、為國王的大臣們、為剎帝利們、為婆羅門們、為屋主們、為青年們：

content: 『在這裡，請你去。在那裡，請你返回。請你帶這個。在那裡，請你取這個。』等。像這樣，是離遣使行走的實行者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(203)

original: 204.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te kuhakā ca honti lapakā ca nemittikā ca nippesikā ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīṃsitāro ca.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣是詭計、攀談、暗示、譏諷、[[kuhanā#以利得換取其他利得]]者，

original: Iti evarūpā kuhanalapanā paṭivirato hoti.
content: 像這樣，是離詭計說話者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ’’.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(204)

original: Majjhimasīlaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
content: 中戒終了。

original: Mahāsīlaṃ
content: 大戒

content: 這也是關於他的戒。(207)

content: 這也是關於他的戒。(208)

original: 209.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti.

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(209)

original: 210.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti.
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣以畜生明邪命謀生，

content: 即：嫁娶[時間]、結婚、離婚、揭幕、討債、貸出、開運、作惡運、墮胎、綁舌[咒術]、使顎被結縛[咒術]、[他人]手控制咒術、顎咒術、耳聾咒術、詢問鏡子[而得答案]、詢問女孩[靈媒]、詢問天、太陽崇拜、大[梵天]崇拜、口吐出火、招請幸運女神等，像這樣，是離以畜生明邪命謀生者，

original: Idampissa hoti sīlasmiṃ.
content: 這也是關於他的戒。(210)

original: 211.‘‘ Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti .
content: 又或，如一些沙門婆羅門尊師吃信施物後，他們像這樣以畜生明邪命謀生，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ vamanaṃ virecanaṃ uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ sīsavirecanaṃ kaṇṇatelaṃ nettatappanaṃ natthukammaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ sālākiyaṃ sallakattiyaṃ dārakatikicchā, mūlabhesajjānaṃ anuppadānaṃ, osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvā paṭivirato hoti.

content: 這也是關於他的戒。(211)

original: evameva kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
content: 同樣的，大王！那位這樣戒具足的比丘他在任何地方都不看見恐怖，即：從戒的自制。

original: Evaṃ kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
content: 大王！這樣，比丘是戒具足者。

original: Mahāsīlaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
content: 大戒終了。

original: Indriyasaṃvaro
content: 根的自制

original: 213.‘‘ Kathañca, mahārāja, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
content: 大王！而怎樣比丘是在諸根上守護門者？

original: Idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
content: 大王！這裡，比丘以眼見色後，不成為相的執取者、[[anubyañjanaso#細相]]的執取者，

original: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
content: 因那個理由，[[abhijjhālu#貪婪]]、憂諸惡不善法會[[nānussavanti#流入]]那位住於眼根不自制者。他走向為了那個的[[saṃvaraṃ#自制]]，守護眼根，在眼根上來到自制；

original: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā… pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā… pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
content: 以耳聽聲音後……（中略）以鼻聞氣味後……（中略）以舌嚐味道後……（中略）以身觸[[gandha#所觸]]後……（中略）以意識知法後，不成為相的執取者、[[anubyañjanaso#細相]]的執取者，

original: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
content: 因那個理由，貪婪、憂諸惡不善法會流入那位住於意根不自制者。他走向為了那個的自制，保護意根，在意根上來到自制。

original: So iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
content: 他具備這聖根自制，感受自身內[[abyāsekasukhaṃ#不受害的安樂]]，

original: Evaṃ kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
content: 大王！這樣，比丘是在諸根上守護門者。(213)

original: Satisampajaññaṃ
content: 念與正知

original: 214.‘‘ Kathañca , mahārāja, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti?
content: 大王！而怎樣比丘具備念與正知？

original: Idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
content: 比丘在前進後退時是[[sampajānakārī#正知的行為者]]；在前視環視時是正知的行為者；在[肢體]屈伸時是正知的行為者；在[[saṅghāṭi#大衣]]、鉢、衣服的受持時是正知的行為者；在飲、食、嚼、嚐時是正知的行為者；在大小便動作時是正知的行為者；在行、住、坐、臥、清醒、語、默狀態時是正知的行為者，

original: Evaṃ kho, mahārāja , bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti.
content: 大王！這樣，比丘具備念與正知。(214)

original: Santoso
content: 知足

original: 215.‘‘ Kathañca, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti?
content: 大王！而怎樣比丘是知足者？

original: Idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena .
content: 大王！比丘是知足者：以衣服保護身體、以施食保護肚子，

original: So yena yeneva pakkamati, samādāyeva pakkamati.
content: 不論出發到何處，他只拿[這些]出發，

original: Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti, sapattabhārova ḍeti.
content: 猶如鳥不論以翼飛到何處，只有翼的負荷而飛。

original: Evameva kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena.
content: 同樣的，大王！比丘以衣服保護身體、以施食保護肚子為知足，

original: So yena yeneva pakkamati, samādāyeva pakkamati.
content: 不論出發到何處，他只拿[這些]出發，

original: Evaṃ kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti.
content: 大王！這樣，比丘是知足者。

original: Nīvaraṇappahānaṃ
content: 蓋的捨斷

original: 216.‘‘ So iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato, imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato, vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
content: 他具備這個聖戒蘊、[具備這個聖知足、]具備這個聖根自制、具備這個聖念與正知，親近遠離(獨居)的臥坐處：林野、樹下、山岳、洞窟、山洞、墓地、森林、露地、稻草堆。

original: So pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātappaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
content: 他[[pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto#餐後已從施食返回]]，坐下，[[pallaṅkena nisīdati#盤腿]]、定置端直的身體、[[parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā#建立面前的念後]]。(216)

original: 217.‘‘ So abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
content: 他捨斷世間中的貪婪，以離貪婪心而住，[[abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti#使心從貪婪淨化]]。

original: Byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
content: 捨斷惡意瞋怒後，住於無瞋害心的、[[pāṇabhūta, pāṇabhūtesu#對一切活的生命類有憐愍的]]，使心從惡意瞋怒淨化。

original: Thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī, sato sampajāno, thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
content: 捨斷惛沈睡眠後，住於離惛沈睡眠的、有[[ālokasaññaṃ#光明想]]的、具念的、正知的，使心從惛沈睡眠淨化。

original: Uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati, ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
content: 捨斷掉舉後悔後，住於不掉舉的、內心寂靜的，使心從掉舉後悔淨化。

original: Vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati, akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
content: 捨斷疑惑後，住於度脫疑惑的、在諸善法上無疑的，使心從疑惑淨化。(217)

original: 218.‘‘ Seyyathāpi , mahārāja, puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya.
content: 大王！猶如男子拿借款後從事諸事業，

original: Tassa te kammantā samijjheyyuṃ.
content: 他的那些事業成功，

original: So yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni, tāni ca byantiṃ kareyya[ byantīkareyya( sī. syā. kaṃ.)], siyā cassa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāya.
content: 凡那些舊借款，對那些，他作終結，且更有剩餘的為他妻子的扶養。

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojesiṃ.
content: 『我之前拿借款後從事諸事業，

original: Tassa me te kammantā samijjhiṃsu.
content: 那個我的那些事業成功，

original: Sohaṃ yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni, tāni ca byantiṃ akāsiṃ, atthi ca me uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāyā’ ti.
content: 凡那些舊借款，對那些，那個我作終結，且更有剩餘的為我妻子的扶養。』

original: So tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
content: 他從那個因由得到欣悅，到達喜悅。(218)

original: 219.‘‘ Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno;
content: 大王！猶如男子是生病者、受苦者、重病者，

original: bhattañcassa nacchādeyya, na cassa kāye balamattā.
content: 食物不使他喜歡，以及在他的身體中沒有足夠的力氣。

original: So aparena samayena tamhā ābādhā mucceyya;
content: 他過些時候從那個病被釋放，

original: bhattaṃ cassa chādeyya, siyā cassa kāye balamattā.
content: 食物使他喜歡，以及在他的身體中有足夠力氣。

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ahaṃ kho pubbe ābādhiko ahosiṃ dukkhito bāḷhagilāno;
content: 『我之前是生病者、受苦者、重病者，

original: bhattañca me nacchādesi, na ca me āsi[ na cassa me( ka.)] kāye balamattā.
content: 食物不使我喜歡，以及在我的身體中沒有足夠的力氣，

original: Somhi etarahi tamhā ābādhā mutto;
content: 那個我現在從那個病被釋放，

original: bhattañca me chādeti, atthi ca me kāye balamattā’ ti.
content: 食物使我喜歡，以及在我的身體中有足夠的力氣。』

original: So tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
content: 他從那個因由得到欣悅，到達喜悅。(219)

original: 220.‘‘ Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, puriso bandhanāgāre baddho assa.
content: 大王！猶如男子被監禁在監獄中，

original: So aparena samayena tamhā bandhanāgārā mucceyya sotthinā abbhayena[ ubbayena( sī. ka.)], na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo.
content: 他過些時候從那個監禁平安地、無恐懼地被釋放，且沒有任何財物的損失，

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ahaṃ kho pubbe bandhanāgāre baddho ahosiṃ, somhi etarahi tamhā bandhanāgārā mutto sotthinā abbhayena.
content: 『我之前被監禁在監獄中，那個我現在從那個監禁平安地、無恐懼地被釋放，

original: Natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo’ ti.
content: 且沒有任何財物的損失。』

original: So tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
content: 他從那個因由得到欣悅，到達喜悅。(220)

original: 221.‘‘ Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, puriso dāso assa anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo.
content: 大王！猶如男子是奴隸、非依靠自己者、依靠他人者、非去想要到的地方者，

original: So aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo.
content: 他過些時候從那個奴隸境遇被釋放，是依靠自己者、不依靠他人者、脫離奴隸者、去想要到的地方者，

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ahaṃ kho pubbe dāso ahosiṃ anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo.
content: 『我之前是奴隸、非依靠自己者、依靠他人者、非去想要到的地方者，

original: Somhi etarahi tamhā dāsabyā mutto attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo’ ti.
content: 那個我現在從那個奴隸境遇被釋放，是依靠自己者、不依靠他人者、脫離奴隸者、去想要到的地方者。』

original: So tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
content: 他從那個因由得到欣悅，到達喜悅。(221)

original: 222.‘‘ Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
content: 大王！猶如有財富、有財產的男子走上飢饉的、有恐怖的曠野道路，

original: So aparena samayena taṃ kantāraṃ nitthareyya sotthinā, gāmantaṃ anupāpuṇeyya khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
content: 他過些時候從那個曠野平安地度脫，安穩地、無恐怖地抵達村落邊界，

original: Tassa evamassa–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
content: 『有財富、有財產的我之前走上飢饉的、有恐怖的曠野道路，

original: Somhi etarahi taṃ kantāraṃ nitthiṇṇo sotthinā, gāmantaṃ anuppatto khemaṃ appaṭibhayan’ ti.
content: 那個我現在從那個曠野平安地度脫，安穩地、無恐怖地抵達村落邊界。』

original: So tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
content: 他從那個因由得到欣悅，到達喜悅。(222)

original: 223.‘‘ Evameva kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhanāgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantāraddhānamaggaṃ, evaṃ ime pañca nīvaraṇe appahīne attani samanupassati.
content: 同樣的，大王！比丘如借款、如疾病、如監獄、如奴隸、如曠野道路般這樣看這些在自己上未捨斷的[[pañca nīvaraṇā#五蓋]]。(223)

original: 224.‘‘ Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, yathā āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khemantabhūmiṃ;
content: 大王！猶如{如-MN.39}無借款、如無疾病、如監禁釋放、如脫離奴隸者、如安穩目的地，

original: evameva kho, mahārāja, bhikkhu ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassati.
content: 大王！同樣的，比丘看這些在自己上已捨斷的五蓋。(224)

original: 225.‘‘ Tassime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
content: 對那位看見自己五蓋已被捨斷者，欣悅被生起；對喜悅者，喜被生起；對[[pīti-mana, pītimano#意喜]]者，身變得寧靜；[[kāyapassaddhi#身已寧靜]]者感受樂；對有樂者，心入定。(225)
